description: Search across 13 online marketplaces. Supported marketplaces: tcgplayer, reverb, grailed, redfin, bonanza, thriftbooks, abebooks, goodreads, offerup, swappa, stubhub, craigslist, poshmark. Returns listings with prices, conditions, seller info, and URLs. Each marketplace specializes in different categories: tcgplayer (trading cards), reverb (music gear), grailed (designer fashion), redfin (real estate), bonanza (general), thriftbooks/abebooks/goodreads (books), offerup/craigslist (local classifieds), swappa (electronics), stubhub (event tickets), poshmark (fashion resale).
